construction: 53 parts in 6 steps. Step 1: a bracket, tan plates and five 1×1 round plates with side handles. Step 2: three `doorcolumn3a` children. Step 3: dark-tan bricks, including a brick 1×2 with two studs on one side. Step 5: five 1.5L clip bars. Step 6: ten leaf plates.
lesson: A stone-texture column built sideways, with vines hung on clip bars from handle plates.
reuse_notes: Chain handle plate, clip bar and leaf plate to hang plants off any sideways wall.
